name: arcturus
label: Arcturus (alpha Boo, K1.5 III)
sources: Lacour et al. 2008, A&A 485, 561 (IOTA/IONIC, H band): Rosseland diameter 21.05 +/- 0.21 mas, limb darkening matching MARCS; Ramirez & Allende Prieto 2011: 21.06 +/- 0.17 mas
Ramirez & Allende Prieto 2011: T_eff 4286 +/- 30 K, log g 1.66, mass 1.08 Msun
van Leeuwen 2007: parallax 88.83 +/- 0.54 mas -> 11.26 pc; Ducati 2002 V -0.05; 2MASS H -2.81, K -2.91 (saturated)
notes: First null 18.6 m at 1550 nm, 10.8 m at 900 nm.
Anchors are Vega magnitudes converted with the band table's Vega -> AB offsets (V +0.02, H +1.39, K +1.85); 900 and 1550 nm fall inside the anchored range.
The radius is derived from theta_LD and the distance. No NewEra model exists below 4700 K: blackbody + linear law.
